newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded again, prices little changed.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded again, prices little changed.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures did not trade on Friday morning, following the two sessions on Thursday when trade was also not done.

Front month July was bid at 10 pence a therm by the close of the session, with offers at 10.225 pence, compared with a settlement price on Thursday of 10.07 pence. Bids were posted in all months as far ahead as February, with offers seen until January. Bids and offers in all cases straddled the previous settlement price, indicating little change to price settlement. No bids or offers were posted further forward.
The contract has had a quiet week with only 70 lots traded so far.
